Corrections are the most useful contribution to this repo. One figure in the original
publication was misattributed and another was unattributed; both are fixed in
[framework/BIBLIOGRAPHY.md](../../framework/BIBLIOGRAPHY.md).

**Where is the error?**
(File and line, if you have it.)

**What does it currently say?**

**What is correct, and what is your source?**
A DOI, arXiv ID or stable URL if there is one. If the claim cannot be sourced, say so: it may
belong in the bibliography marked `unverified` rather than removed.
